name: Deterministic Resume-to-Job Alignment Rubric
disclaimer: This score represents deterministic textual and evidence alignment between the candidate resume and target job requirements. It does not measure innate ability, placement probability, or hiring guarantees.

components.name: Required Technical Skills Coverage
components.description: Ratio of required technical skills present in the resume with demonstrable evidence.

components.name: Project & Practical Implementation Evidence
components.description: Evaluation of whether skills are contextualized in concrete projects, GitHub repositories, or deliverables.

components.name: Role Domain & Responsibility Alignment
components.description: Semantic alignment between candidate experience descriptions and target job duties.

components.name: Quantified Achievement & Impact Metrics
components.description: Presence of quantifiable business or technical metrics (percentages, throughput, latency, revenue, scale).

components.name: Structure, Completeness & Readability
components.description: Presence of core resume sections (Education, Projects, Skills, Experience) and clean typographical formatting.
